Bagel Thins
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:27pm

Ingredients




1 bagel
1 teaspoon dried oregano
2 teaspoons soft margarine -- melted

Preparation

1 Using a very sharp serrated knife, slice bagel into very thin rounds. 2 Arrange in single layer on baking sheet; brush with margarine. Sprinkle with oregano. Bake in 350 F oven for 12 minutes. Let cool and store in airtight container for up to 1 week.
